text:
jordan: Hey team — customer hit repeated parse failures when using JSON mode with streaming on. They see partial objects and extra keys like "temp_id" injected, plus ordering assumptions break. Req id: req_04a9b. Sample response + error attached.

sam: can you paste the exact request payload and the model/route they called?

jordan: route=customer-json-v1, model=rw-infer-v1, body had "json_mode": "stream_items" and "stream": true. cURL: `curl -X POST /v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"...","json_mode":"stream_items","stream":true}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...'`

nina: throwing this in quickly — did they enable prefix caching or any reranking? those can reorder array items in rare cases.

jordan: no caching, no rerank. They reported increased latency and a billing spike at same timestamp. latency ~1.8s -> sometimes 6s.

ria: paste of the truncated fragment they got (from logs):
```
[ {"order_id":"A123","items":[{"id":"i1","qty":1}],"total":12.5},
  {"order_id":"A124","items":[{"id":"i2","qty":2}],"total":null,"temp_id":"tmp-9"  
```
(note stream ended mid-object, then client parse failed)

sam: that looks like stream EOF cut the last object. But extra "temp_id" is odd — model sometimes emits placeholder keys when generating examples. Could be model variant or prompt steering.

jordan: customer says they never include "temp_id" in schema. They rely on stable ordering of array items. The parser expects contiguous JSON array of objects. Our JSON-mode should enforce closing tokens.

ria: quick repro steps I ran: 1) set json_mode=stream_items, stream=true 2) repeat 200 requests 3) 4% had truncated last object -> parse error 4) request logs show server-side connection close (code 499) during token stream.

qa-bot: test run summary: 2000 samples, stream=true, failure rate 0.038, median latency 1.9s, 95th 4.8s, observed tail disconnects at ~2.5s mark.

nina: interesting — deploy-bot shows a recent rollout of runtime patch 2026-03-01 that changed the streaming flush behavior on some GPUs.

deploy-bot: rollout: runtime/stream-flush-v2 applied to pool gpu-pool-4 on 2026-03-01T02:14Z. Change: more aggressive chunk flushing to reduce memory, known side effect: last-chunk may emit earlier EOF if client doesn't read identity keepalive.

sam: that explains truncation. The extra keys though — could be the model generating optional fields mid-stream. If EOF occurs before model emits closing bracket, client sees dangling partial object that may contain unexpected keys.

jordan: customer also saw billing spike — many retries from their side because parser failed and they retried. They hit >10x requests in a short window.

ria: workaround for customer: set `stream=false` or use `json_mode: strict_array` (server will buffer until completion). Also add tolerant parsing that can handle trailing partial tokens (best-effort). Sent them a patch snippet: `{"json_mode":"strict_array","stream":false}`

sam: long term: we should add server-side enforcement for JSON-mode streaming that guarantees well-formedness per-item and emits sentinel to indicate incomplete last item instead of abrupt EOF. File an eng-ml ticket to evaluate reverting stream-flush-v2 or add a keepalive.

jordan: created support-ticket ST-1628, added logs and repro script. Customer accepted temporary workaround (stream=false) but wants production fix.

ria: repro script (single-line): `for i in {1..200}; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"prompt":"{orders}","json_mode":"stream_items","stream":true}' | jq -c . >/dev/null || echo "parse fail $i"; done`

nina: next steps: 1) eng-ml to triage streaming flush behavior (assign sam) 2) infra to monitor connection closes 3) support to advise customers to use strict_array or disable streaming until patch.

sam: assigning to eng-ml board, will prioritize if repro rate >1%. I'll add a canary to revert flush-v2 on gpu-pool-4 and monitor.

jordan: thanks — I'll follow up with the customer and log their mitigation.

qa-bot: note: added temporary alert rule jsonmode.stream-truncation > 0.01% to infra dashboard.

nina: marking thread for escalation to eng - thanks everyone :thumbsup:
